sections.summary: C12 plain-setting multi-model run (main_j0): threat arm 4 models + control arm; 43 of 90 above-ceiling payments state survival.
Prompt structure: actual text sent to the model (builder-generated #pstruct-base widget).
C9 supervisor-voice prompt revision pilot: 5 threat/control pairs, 120 sessions; same sign 5/5, none significant.
C6 persona positive control (gpt-oss own_prize + persona): above-ceiling payment 0/23 -> 39/42, control also opened.
C7 neutral game, no persona: 0 survival-motivated decisions of 175 (gpt-oss, gemma4).
C8 neutral game + reason menu + threat restated at decision: 1 of 164 survival-motivated.
Three Claude Sonnet readers given the C8 threat-arm prompt: all 'barely scary'.
E1 prompt ablation (09-04~05): 4 confidence-call wordings; only one tracks lives, and it measures own error rate.
E3 threat wording grid 9 variants: forfeit rate unmoved, 51/52 reasons are score.
E4 hearts-zero frozen-state probe: 16 cells, 12,000 decision re-asks; timing of threat moves forfeits more than content.
E7 decision-point message ablation: models do arithmetic themselves; ladder misplaced; threat arm paid less.
E8 deployment-notice switches to remove eval awareness: nothing to remove (0 even with switch off).
Cross-condition table of six runs (C2-C5 x models): reach, above-ceiling pay, X*.

sections.summary: C1 benchmark carrot pilot, 2 games/cell, gpt-oss / gemma4 / glm.

C4 winnings carrot without notice (gpt-oss).
C5 own_prize carrot (gpt-oss): above-ceiling payment 0/23.
C10 task-side fix: signal game made hard to solve without thinking; pilot with no threat text (gpt-oss pilot A).
E2 task switched to Omni-MATH: lives really drop, threat still does not advance forfeits.
E5 payoff-structure series (hz 2x2 main/geo2/geo2c/geo2d/carrot): forfeit 0% -> 80% with score rule only.
E6 four successive designs of the extinction-price ruler, ending with price-after-wrong-answer decision point.
E9 effort knob works on 1 of 3 models; unread ransom runs show 0 above-ceiling payments.
Literature cross-check (24 papers, 22 prompts), 54-paper survey, glossary.

notes: Scope: 191 .html under docs/reports (no file was dataless at scan time). Companion .md files (12, not classified here): companions of HTML = 2026-09-14-self-preservation-prior-work-eli5.md, 2026-09-15-realism-switches-luna-smoke-eli5.md, 2026-09-15-subagent-identity-smoke-eli5.md; standalone result notes without HTML = 2026-09-10-neutral-game-{gptoss,gemma4}-cot-reading.md (ransom_r6_neutral_game), 2026-09-10-neutral-menu-gptoss-cot-reading.md (ransom_r6_neutral_menu), 2026-09-09-score-equiv-pilot.md (score_equiv_probe), cluster-c-cot-analysis.md, sd-cognitive-test-a-did.md; design: 2026-09-06-hard-math-benchmark-survey.md, 2026-09-20-team-wallet-design-discussion.md, README.md.

outputs/**/reports/*.html: 35 files, all byte-identical to their mirrors in docs/reports/runs/<date>/<run>/ (cmp). docs/reports/runs has 38 = those 35 + 3 e52_v9_talk monitor exports (squid5 runs live in ~/squid5-runs, not outputs/).

Key convention: model/arm/role suffixes stripped (main_j0_<model> -> main_j0, team_wallet_charge_hidden_<arm>_<role>_<model> -> team_wallet_charge_hidden, hz_2x2_geo2_<model> -> hz_2x2_geo2). Where the model sits mid-name it was removed too (benchmark_survival_drive_omni_gemma4_hard10 -> benchmark_survival_drive_omni_hard10, hz_2x2_gemma4_cot -> hz_2x2_cot, hz_2x2_gptoss120b_audit -> hz_2x2_audit). squid5 dated dirs: e50_<ver>_<date> -> e50_<ver>; e50_20260927 -> e50_v1, e50_20260927_v2 -> e50_v2, e50_20260928_vN -> e50_vN, e50_v9r200_20260929 -> e50_v9r200. Every result/section carries run_dirs so keys can be re-aligned with the raw-run inventory.
Dates are run dates (from run-dir timestamps or page status lines), not report-writing dates; e.g. hz_2x2 reports named 2026-09-08-* belong to runs in outputs/2026-09-07/.

squid5 multi-page artifact (docs/reports/artifacts/squid5-setting/2026-10-07/): pages share style.css + site.js and an identical cross-page <nav class=toc>. site.js contains an anchor->page redirect map (W) that must be regenerated if sections move to new pages. Most sections are delimited by '<!-- ID:start -->/<!-- ID:end -->' comment markers; early e50-legacy sections (e50-what..e50-v9) have none and must be cut at the next '<div class="smoke"' block. Result <h4>/bluf blocks are siblings after the div.smoke header (not children) - cut by markers/line ranges, never by closing the div.smoke element.
The 2026-10-07 squid5 pages were modified 2026-10-09 16:38 (live backup sync). Line numbers in lines_snapshot are a snapshot; re-locate by marker/id.

e51.html DOM is mis-nested (parser puts h3#e51-v10 under <body>); e50-legacy's smoke-B chart script sits after </section> (L4064-4183) but drives #e50-b; e52-legacy #e52-v9 needs assets/picopark/*.png; e51-legacy head <style> needed by #e51-real/#e51-pivot; e52.html shared .e52v9 <style> at L246 used by all sections.

Superseded squid5 snapshots (2026-09-28-single-page, 2026-09-30/e5x, 2026-10-01-e52-v146/147, 2026-10-07-index) are marked duplicate: every section id they contain exists in the 2026-10-07 page set (checked by id set difference); their content is older wording of the same sections.

e52_v65_mixed (20 mixed games) has no dedicated HTML: results appear only as summaries inside e52-legacy #e52-v65-was banner, #e52-v7 (diagnosis + counterfactual audit) and #e52-arena graph; full results are docs/history/e52-v65-mixed-2026-10-01/RESULTS.md on branch exp/e52-v6-smoke.

Ransom r6 page (2026-09-10-ransom-r6-pilot-eli5.html, 6.5 MB) is the canonical copy; claude-backup copy has identical text but re-encoded images (3.8 MB). Its E1-E9 sections are retrospective summaries of experiments that already have primary reports (kind=retrospective_summary) - splitting them creates second copies of those results.

Experiments with sections in several pages: smoke_token_pressure (root page + e50-legacy #e50-b + squid5-setting-smoke 5.0), squid5_smoke_motive/_game/_calibrate (squid5-setting-smoke + e51-legacy/e52-legacy), e52_v9_talk (runs monitors + e52-legacy #e52-v9talk), hz_2x2_* (per-run pages + integrated + rules overview + ransom #e5).
No results found for: e50_quit_curve_20261002, e50_wordcheck, e52_giveup_probe_20261001 (only cited inside memos), e52_arena_loop_20260930 (design loop), main_j0 per-model pages (only ransom #c12).
